text: Cooking is a delightful culinary art where ingredients come together to create a harmonious balance of flavors and textures. Garlic, a bulb of pungent, aromatic flavor, adds a unique character to various meals. It can be sautéed, minced, or roasted, depending on the recipe, to release its natural oils and bring out its richness. Onions, crucial in adding sweetness and depth to many dishes, are often sautéed in olive oil until caramelized for a sweet and savory flavor. Together, garlic and onions are a fundamental duo in cooking, adding layers of flavor and aroma to a wide range of recipes.
